title: HeatedBuildingRisk
description: Contract for Brain Migration Slice 2 — Stage 1 heated-building risk rule. Contract version 1.0.0 (same overall JSON Schema contract convention as door-size-default.schema.json; no breaking change, so no contract-version bump). Canonical source of truth: this file, in Project-Check-Brain. Any copy elsewhere (e.g. vendored into the application repository) is a mechanically identical mirror, never independently edited.

HeatedInput.description: The raw Stage 1 'heated' answer. Only the exact string 'Yes' triggers a risk — comparison is case-sensitive exact match. Any other string (including empty, null, undefined, or an unrecognised/legacy value) is valid input and must produce a null output.

RiskOutput.description: The risk this rule contributes to p.risks1, or null when the rule does not fire.

text.const: A heated building introduces thermal-performance and energy-compliance requirements that need to be coordinated with the building specification.
